text: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects and phenomena. To observe the vastness of the cosmos, astronomers often use telescopes, powerful devices that magnify distant stars, galaxies, and nebulae. Telescopes allow scientists to see details in the universe that are often invisible to the naked eye, such as the intricate patterns in nebulae and the distant, bright dots that are stars. Through telescopes, astronomers uncover the history of the universe, including the formation of galaxies and the evolution of planetary systems. The study of astronomy not only broadens our understanding of the universe but also inspires curiosity about our place in the cosmos.
